title: Compute attention and then impose causality

Explain why replacing the forbidden score with 0 instead of excluding it is incorrect, and identify which variables may vary while preserving linearity inV.
hintLadder: Mask the candidate set before normalising.
State which quantities are held fixed in a linearity claim.
